explicit_validation.explanation: The paper explicitly validates GPT-4-o-mini's evaluation capabilities against human evaluation for comment-KP matching annotation, reporting Pearson correlation and accuracy metrics

prompts.notes: Exact prompts provided in appendices for various evaluation tasks including KP extraction and comment-KP matching

inter_annotator_agreement.value: Not explicitly reported but used for quality control (annotators with Cohen's kappa < 0 excluded)
inter_annotator_agreement.interpretation: Used for filtering annotators rather than reporting overall agreement

guidelines.notes: Detailed annotation guidelines provided for comment-KP matching with categorical scale (Not At All, Somewhat Not Well, Somewhat Well, Very Well)

sample_size.notes: Validation conducted on comment-KP pairs from the annotation process

quantitative_scores.notes: Statistically significant correlation between LLM and human annotations
Overall accuracy of LLM annotations compared to human consensus

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4-o-mini annotations show statistically significant positive correlation (r=0.647, p=5.342e-16) and high accuracy (80.7%) with human judgments for comment-KP matching tasks.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM used primarily for matching evaluation while humans evaluated broader summary quality dimensions; overlapping validation conducted specifically on comment-KP matching accuracy
